newsitem.title: CHINA: China Overseas to set US$100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas to set US$100 mln loan.

text.p: China Overseas Land and Investment has mandated SocGen Asia to arrange a US$100 million loan facility, bankers said.

They said the facility has a final maturity of five years with revolving credit for the first three years and a term loan facility thereafter. It pays an interest margin of 100 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate for first three years and 130 basis points thereafter.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 140 basis points.
Proceeds are to be used for general corporate purposes.
An arranger group is being formed.
